meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin during Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **thicker, fragrance-free moisturizer with ceramides + humectants**. Winter’s low humidity increases moisture loss, and ceramides help support the skin barrier. **🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream**  
Three ceramides + hyaluronic acid, rich enough for dry-to-very-dry skin, and fragrance-free/non-comedogenic. This would be my **first choice for a typical Indian winter**. [www.ceraveindia.com](https://www.ceraveindia.com/skin-smart/skincare-tips-advice/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**💰 Best value: Cetaphil DAM**  
A good choice if you want something nourishing but generally less expensive. Cetaphil specifically recommends its richer moisturizers for winter dryness. **🧴 For very dry/flaky skin: Venusia Max**  
A richer cream option if your skin gets particularly tight, rough or flaky in winter.

**🌿 If you prefer a lighter feel: Dot & Key Ceramide + HA**  
Better if you dislike the heavier feel of traditional winter creams.

**Simple routine:** Apply moisturizer to slightly damp skin after cleansing, morning and night. In the daytime, finish with **SPF 30–50 sunscreen**, even in winter.
